description: The files export.drawing wrote, as read back from disk.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

document.description: The drawing, as it is after the export: same path; its unsaved-changes flag the same unless marked_dirty.

sheets.description: The sheets written, in the drawing's order.

items.description: A file export.drawing wrote, as read back from disk.

sheets.description: The sheets it holds, in order.

header.description: What it starts with: %PDF- and its version, DXF, or the DWG's version (AC1032).

items.description: A PDF page export.drawing wrote, as read back from the file.

width_mm.description: Its width as shown (its media box, turned by its /Rotate), mm.

pages.description: A PDF's pages, in order; empty for DXF and DWG.

from.description: Where they were read: its entities (the header's $EXTMIN/$EXTMAX is reported in checks, not compared).

extents.description: A DXF's extents: the rectangle its entities fill, sheet mm; absent for PDF and DWG.

view.description: A DXF's largest view, whose drawn extents were found among its entities; absent when its sheet has no view, and for PDF and DWG.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

view_extents.description: The extents that view's entities fill in the file, sheet mm.

files.description: The files written: one PDF, or one DXF or DWG per sheet.

marked_dirty.description: True when the export marked a drawing that had no unsaved changes as having them (SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP4 may, and the API cannot clear the flag). It was not saved to clear it; its sheets, views, annotations and tables are measured unchanged.

preferences.description: The SOLIDWORKS export preferences set for the call and put back afterwards, each as name = value.

warnings.description: What SOLIDWORKS warned about while exporting (swFileSaveWarning_e names).

checks.description: Each check made on the files and the drawing, and what it found.
